payload.claim: This docstring now lists only 'a failed `gh`, a `PreflightFailed`, an `OSError` reading that file' as what escapes `run_regate`'s try block to the caller, dropping the previous mention of `PackageError`. But `_fetch` (regate.py:76-83) still wraps a `ParentGone` into a bare `package_phase.PackageError` and raises it from inside the same try block (called at lines 147-148), which still escapes uncaught and exits 2 exactly as before — this is required by this spec's own acceptance criteria ('A branch `run_regate` cannot fetch still exits 2'). The docstring no longer says so, so it understates what still reaches the caller.
